reply.text:
Six months out from an ACL reconstruction, whether plyos are back on the table is a call for your surgeon or physio. They'll know your graft, your testing and your clearance. That's a medical decision, not a coaching one, so I'm not adding anything jumpy to your program until they've signed off.

Once they've told you what's cleared, bring it to me, including anything they want kept out, and I'll build around it. Until then I'm glad to keep the rest of your training moving.
